مَوَدَّةٌ Love; affection. (Msb.) See also 1. ―
-b2- Also, A letter; an epistle: and letters, or epistles: syn. كِتَابٌ and كُتُبٌ. (IAar, L, K.) Said to have the latter meaning in the Kur, lx. 1, in the first of the instances of its occurrence there: (L, K:) but this is a strange interpretation. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
